summary: Short-period ESE/E windswell is spread thin early week with only dawn glass to work with — Rockaway and Matunuck are the cleaner dawn calls Wednesday but nothing's drive-worthy yet. A flat spell sets in Friday and Saturday, then the real signal arrives for the weekend into Monday. Rockaway's fine for a fun home session Sunday, but the drive that pays off is Manasquan on Monday: 3ft-plus at a genuine 6-7s with offshore dawn, the one clean, organized day of the week.
